dataset.title: ThermBuild: Real-world and simulated thermal data from 960 residential multi-zone buildings in Central Europe

published_but_not_in_local_raw.role: Same TwinHouse series with kNN (k=5) gap fill
Fordatis description file (32 B on the record page)

meta.hydraulics: direct-coupled; 50 L defrost buffer; no DHW
meta.source: filename encoding + Raisch et al. arXiv:2606.01994

time.timestamp_inference: TIME is a monotonic integer 15-minute sample index (step 1), not hours and not Unix time. consecutive_days 1–444 with day_of_the_year 38→116. Interior days have 96 samples (full 24 h). First and last days are partial. No clock time or timezone column exists.

heat_pump.cop_definition: hp_thP / hp_elP where hp_elP > 0.05 kW and hp_thP > 0

aux_heater_proxy.rule: hp_elP > 0.5 kW AND hp_rps < 1/s (compressor essentially off)

occupancy_internal_gains.note: TwinHouses are unoccupied labs. Internal heat gains are electrical simulators (Occdem profiles), not household electricity.

meta.hydraulics: storage-coupled; 825 L DHW + 500 L heating buffer + ~6 m2 solar thermal
meta.source: filename encoding + Raisch et al. arXiv:2606.01994
